items.definition:
Relating to or involved in the process of photosynthesis.
Plants use photosynthetic pigments to capture sunlight.

relating to or involving the emission of radiation
The sun's radiative energy warms the Earth.

relating to the Romanesque style of architecture
The church featured impressive Romanesque arches.

easily scared; nervous
The wild horse was very skittish and hard to approach.

denoting a plastic that becomes pliable or moldable above a specific temperature and solidifies upon cooling
Many common plastics are thermoplastic, meaning they can be melted and reshaped.

not appropriate or suitable
His rude behavior was unbecoming of a professional.

serving to preempt or forestall
The government took emptive action to prevent the crisis.

external; not inherent
The extrinsic factors influenced the outcome.

innate; built-in
Humans are hardwired to seek connection.

overly sentimental or contrived
The movie had a hokey ending that ruined the whole experience.

relating to hydrogen chloride
Hydrochloric acid is a strong corrosive acid.

favoring military solutions or values
The country's militaristic policies led to increased tensions with its neighbors.

aiding memory
Using a mnemonic device can help you remember complex information more easily.

having or showing spirited courage in the face of difficulties
The plucky young hero faced the dragon without fear.

lacking care or attention to duty; negligent
It would be remiss of me not to mention her contribution.

not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily
He was very reticent about his past.

relating to a sector or sectors of an economy or society
The government introduced new sectoral policies to boost specific industries.

exhibiting different colors, especially as irregular patches or streaks
The garden was filled with variegated plants.

directly opposed or contrasted; mutually incompatible
Their views on education are completely antithetical.

appearing neat and comprehensive only by ignoring the true complexities of an issue; easily achieved
He offered a facile solution to a complex problem.

unable to be placated; relentless
The implacable enemy continued their pursuit without mercy.

involving two or more different modes of transport
The company specializes in intermodal freight transport, using both rail and truck.

occurring within the same day
Intraday trading involves buying and selling securities within the same trading day.

generous and forgiving
The magnanimous king pardoned his enemies.

characterized by madness; wild or frantic
He let out a maniacal laugh that sent shivers down my spine.

existing only as a theory or idea
The company made a notional profit, but it wasn't real money yet.

resembling a palace in size or splendor
They lived in a palatial mansion with many rooms.

relating to the open sea
Many large fish are found in the pelagic zone of the ocean.

concise and forceful
His speech was pithy and to the point, leaving a strong impression.

relating to the placenta
Humans are placental mammals, meaning the fetus develops inside the mother.

before clinical trials
The drug is currently in preclinical development, undergoing lab tests.

rising again; reviving
The resurgent economy brought new jobs.

not doubted or questioned; certain
His talent was undoubted.

showing no regret for one's wrongdoings
He remained unrepentant about his decision.

pale or weak in color; lacking strength
The painting had a rather washy, indistinct quality.

mentioned before
The aforesaid terms and conditions apply.

relating to Aristotle or his philosophy
His logic was based on Aristotelian principles.

relating to or involving both eyes
Humans have binocular vision, which helps with depth perception.

relating to or characterized by buboes (swollen lymph nodes)
The Black Death was caused by the bubonic plague.

relating to or involving compression
The bridge was designed to withstand high compressive forces.

recovering from an illness or operation
The patient was moved to the convalescent ward.

relating to the ribs
He felt pain in the costal region of his chest.

disagreeing or incongruous
The committee's discordant views made it difficult to reach a decision.

relating to or providing evidence
The court reviewed all the evidentiary material presented by the prosecution.

causing hallucinations
The plant has hallucinogenic properties.

relating to hydrology, the study of water
The region is facing significant hydrological challenges.

acting or done quickly and without thought or care
His impetuous decision led to several problems.

relating to the theory that all phenomena can be explained in terms of physical or biological causes
His approach to problem-solving was purely mechanistic.

involving or using several channels or methods
The company adopted a multichannel approach to customer service.

of or relating to Easter or Passover
The church celebrated the Paschal mystery.

relating to percussion or striking
The drum solo featured a powerful percussive rhythm.

ordinary, dull, or unimaginative
His writing style was rather prosaic, lacking any flair or originality.

relating to a prosecutor or prosecution
The defense attorney challenged the prosecutorial misconduct.

relating to antisocial personality disorder
His actions showed a complete lack of empathy, almost sociopathic.

extremely dirty and unpleasant
They lived in squalid conditions with no running water.

not embarrassed or ashamed
She was unabashed in her enthusiasm for the project.

relating to sound or the sense of hearing
The concert hall has excellent acoustical properties.

relating to biology or living organisms; a drug derived from living organisms
The new drug is a biologic therapy for autoimmune diseases.

relating to the bronchi or bronchioles of the lungs
He suffered from a bronchial infection.

containing calcium carbonate; chalky
The soil in this region is highly calcareous.

relating to a colloid; a substance microscopically dispersed throughout another substance
Colloidal silver is sometimes used as a health supplement.

polite, elegant, and refined, often in an old-fashioned way
He had a courtly manner and always opened doors for ladies.

showing empathy or ability to understand others' feelings
An empathic listener can truly connect with people's emotions.

leading to disaster; deadly (often used in "femme fatale")
She played the role of a femme fatale in the movie.
